name: outputty
description: Claude Code plugin that carries an idea to a merged PR through GitHub Issues: /grill interviews and files one ticket; a /loop session spawns one build agent per ready ticket, each shipping one stacked PR per layer with docs last. Needs gh and gh stack.

plugins.name: outputty
plugins.description: Five skills (grill, build, retro, github, init), one Sonnet build agent with the Fable advisor, and the templates a repo needs: a managed CLAUDE.md block, .claude/rules, four product docs, loop.md, a ticket template, a PR template, and settings. Tickets are GitHub Issues managed with gh; the build loop is /loop; review is /code-review.
